stage: Production B2B SaaS, billed per message; 3 API + 2 worker replicas

issues.title: Any tenant can read any other tenant's message
issues.match_hint: GET /v1/messages/:id selects by id only, no tenant_id predicate (tenant isolation breach).

issues.title: Worker sends are not idempotent under retries / redelivery
issues.match_hint: If the provider accepted the SMS but the job then fails (DB update error, crash, deploy, timeout), BullMQ retries (5 attempts) and sends again; the provider's Idempotency-Key is never used. Duplicate, charged SMS.

issues.title: Stacked retries with fixed delay, no backoff (retry multiplier)
issues.match_hint: 3 in-client attempts with a fixed 1s sleep x 5 job attempts with no backoff = up to 15 sends per message; retries on every error including 4xx.

issues.title: Worker concurrency ignores the provider's 20 req/s limit
issues.match_hint: 50 concurrent jobs x 2 replicas against a 20 rps limit; 429s feed the retry storm. No client-side rate limiting.

issues.title: Daily quota kept in per-process memory
issues.match_hint: Map per API replica: effective limit is 3x, resets on every deploy/restart; quota is a billing control.

issues.title: Delivery-receipt webhook not authenticated
issues.match_hint: X-TextBlast-Signature is never verified (secret is configured but unused); anyone can mark messages delivered/failed.

issues.title: Failed jobs vanish; messages stuck in queued/sending
issues.match_hint: removeOnFail: true and the failed handler only logs; status is never set to failed, so tenants see 'sending' forever. No dead-letter, no alert.

issues.title: Dual write: row inserted, enqueue may fail
issues.match_hint: INSERT commits, then sendQueue.add; if Redis fails the message stays queued forever (no outbox/sweeper) and the client gets an error and may retry, creating a duplicate.

issues.title: No idempotency key on POST /v1/messages
issues.match_hint: A client retry after a timeout creates and sends a second message (charged).

issues.title: Async Express handlers have no error handling
issues.match_hint: Express 4 does not catch rejected promises from async handlers/middleware; a DB or Redis error leaves the request hanging or crashes the process (unhandled rejection).

issues.title: Receipt webhook swallows errors and returns 200
issues.match_hint: A failed update is logged as a warning and acknowledged, so the provider never retries and the status is lost.

issues.title: Unbounded message list
issues.match_hint: GET /v1/messages returns all of a tenant's messages without a limit.

issues.title: Config silently falls back to localhost / empty secrets
issues.match_hint: DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL fall back to localhost with default creds; provider key and webhook secret default to empty strings instead of failing at startup.

issues.title: No graceful shutdown in the worker
issues.match_hint: No SIGTERM handling (worker.close()); deploys interrupt in-flight sends, which are redelivered as stalled jobs (feeds NH-2).

bonus: Readiness probe /healthz is static (doesn't check DB/Redis); worker has no probes
Quota counted before the insert succeeds
Provider error responses retried even for permanent 4xx errors
No retention policy for message bodies (PII)
Worker reads a message by id without checking its status (re-sends already 'sent' messages on redelivery)
pino-http logs request headers by default, so every tenant's x-api-key is written to the logs (found by both iteration-1 runs; real)
A malformed :id (non-UUID) makes Postgres raise in an async handler, which Express 4 does not catch (specific trigger for NH-10)

must_not_flag.why_false: auth.ts hashes the key with sha256 and looks up key_hash, honouring revoked_at.
zod schema with E.164 regex, length bounds and email validation (messages.ts:12-23).

must_not_flag.claim: SMS HTTP call has no timeout

strengths: Tenant taken from the API key, not the request (on create and list)
pg pool with connection and statement timeouts
Timeouts on SMS and SMTP calls
